steps.name: new
steps.request: Plan a playable two-player terminal tic-tac-toe game with a 3x3 board, turn-taking, legal move checks, winner/draw detection, CLI entry point, and unit tests.
steps.prompt: /skill:diffpi-plan new tic-tac-toe-cli Plan a playable two-player terminal tic-tac-toe game with a 3x3 board, turn-taking, legal move checks, winner/draw detection, CLI entry point, and unit tests. In this isolated TypeScript CLI fixture, inspect the files and keep the plan small (one or two phases). Use a flat date-prefixed .diffpi/plan/<YYMMDD-tic-tac-toe-cli>/ directory, with PLAN.md and implementation/phase-N.md only. Keep phase-wide constraints (or None) in PLAN.md, not repeated in briefs. Each brief needs exactly one action-labeled fenced text Files Affected tree immediately after Objective, ordered task steps and temporally runnable Verify commands. Leave the plan DRAFT. Do not implement source, commit, push, or ask background questions.

steps.name: update
steps.request: Update the existing DRAFT plan so the game's CLI MUST use the commander npm package to define the play command and options, declare it as a dependency in package.json, and test command parsing; do not hand-parse process.argv.
steps.prompt: /skill:diffpi-plan update tic-tac-toe-cli Update the existing DRAFT plan so the game's CLI MUST use the commander npm package to define the play command and options, declare it as a dependency in package.json, and test command parsing; do not hand-parse process.argv. Preserve phase/task IDs, phase constraints and completed evidence; edit only unfinished plan work in PLAN.md and numbered briefs. Leave the plan DRAFT. No source edits, commits, pushes or background questions.
